title: Internal Motion and Assembly in Neural Models
story: What moves inside a model, how fragments form, and how they assemble into a usable configuration.

title: Reasoning Dynamics and Discrete Output
story: How continuous internal computation passes through a discrete token interface, and how each token participates in the next state change.

title: How Loss Functions Shape Reasoning
story: How training objectives shape acceptance regions, approach trajectories and the passage of a complete reasoning chain.

title: Formation and Handoff of Internal Computation
story: How reusable computational interfaces form, and how causal load moves between states, markers and readout stages.

title: Attention Coordination and Candidate Routing
story: How candidate retrieval, head coordination and ranked routing contribute to later assembly.

title: Error Diagnosis and Local Repair
story: How measured error paths lead to scoped interventions, repair permissions, checkpoint compatibility and maintenance.

title: Information Transport and Assembly Across Architectures
story: Which transport and assembly properties are shared across architectures, and which depend on their implementation.
